description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake commands, including normalization of tokens, checking if transcript starts with specified triggers, and extracting text commands with trimming and validation.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token by trimming whitespace and punctuation and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the specified trigger phrases.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command text from the transcript if it matches trigger conditions, is of sufficient length, and passes wake word gate checks.
